en: Know what every cake costs and what to charge before you quote
Recipe costing, cake quotes and margins for home bakeries and cake businesses
Recipe costing with live ingredient prices
every recipe line takes today's price per kilogram or piece, so a butter or flour change reaches every product cost at once
Cost per serving for every product
ingredient, packaging, labour and energy add up to the total cost, the profit per unit, the margin and the cost per serving of all 24 products
Custom cake quote by size, tiers and decoration
choose size, flavour, decoration and zone and see cost, price, delivery fee, margin, deposit and sales tax before you answer the client
Tiered cake planner by guest count
type the guests and see the smallest cake that serves them with its tiers, kilograms of sponge, filling and frosting and cost per serving
set a margin for each product category and see the price you need, the rise still missing and the products below target
Ingredient price rise impact on every product
a test rise on one ingredient shows the extra cost and the margin left for every product and the cost across all recipes
the wholesale discount, the margin per unit and a flag when cafes and shops pay a price below your wholesale margin goal
your price against a local shop and a home baker for each product, with the latest check marked and the gap to the average
planned and real minutes of each job show the gap in hours and money, so a decoration that always runs long gets a new price
uplifts for busy weeks and discounts for slow weeks with dates, products and an active, starting soon or ended status
Order profit sample with loss check
each order shows profit and margin against the category target, so a three-tier cake priced below its cost stands out
Cost by month for every product
ingredient cost at each month's prices and the list price then give a monthly margin that shows how costs slowly eat the margin

Products with full cost, margin and cost per serving
The 24 products with list and wholesale price; the full cost, margin, cost per serving, the price for your target margin and the effect of a test price rise fill in by themselves.
Extra cost after the test rise
Recipe lines at today's ingredient prices
One row for each ingredient or packaging item in a recipe, in grams or pieces; the unit cost comes from Ingredients and the line cost and its share of the product cost fill in by themselves.
Ingredients with today's price and where they are used
The 38 ingredients and packaging items with the price per kilogram or piece; the cost per 100 grams, the recipes that use each and the effect of the test price rise fill in.
Cake sizes with sponge, filling and frosting cost
The 12 cake sizes with servings, tiers, kilograms of sponge, filling and frosting and the minutes to bake and assemble; the material, labour and energy cost and the cost per serving fill in.
Decoration levels with price and labour factors
The price factor and the labour factor for each decoration level; the quote builder and the quote table use them to price decoration.
Quotes with estimated cost, margin and the deposit
One row for each quote sent with the quoted price and its status; the estimated cost, margin, the price against the list price, the deposit and the follow-up check fill in by themselves.
Orders with profit and margin against the target
A sample of recent and past orders with the price and the cost of each; the profit, the margin and the check against the target of the category fill in, so an order sold at a loss stands out.
One row for each change of a list price with the old and the new price and the reason; the change in money and in percent fill in, and the last change date feeds Products.
One row for each change of an ingredient price with the old and the new cost and the supplier; the change in percent and the direction fill in, and the last change date feeds Ingredients.
Oven programs with the energy cost of one bake
The 14 oven programs with minutes, tray loads and power in kW; the kWh used, the energy cost of one bake and the cost per tray load fill in.
The margin you want in each product category; the number of products below it fills in and every product and order is checked against it.
Wholesale price list with the margin for cafes and shops
Products sold wholesale (to cafes and shops at a lower price) with the main account; the retail price, discount, cost and wholesale margin fill in, and a trial price is marked.
Packaging items with the price from each supplier
The boxes, boards, bags and labels you use with their cost each and the supplier; the recipe lines and the sizes pick these costs up.
Event cake guide by number of guests
For each guest count the cake size, the tiers, the servings and the suggested flavour; the extra servings, the price estimate and whether the cake serves everyone fill in.
Seasonal price rules with the dates and the uplift
The price uplifts or discounts you apply in busy and slow weeks, with dates and the products affected; the status and an example price for the category fill in.
Competitor price checks against local shops and home bakers
One row for each price check with your price, a local shop price and a home baker price; the gap to their average and your position fill in, with the latest check per product marked.
Recipe tests with the cost change and the taste score
One row for each recipe change you tried with its cost change per unit, the taste score and the decision; the baker phone and the cost change as a share of the ingredient cost fill in.
Ingredient cost and margin of every product by month
One row for each product and month with the ingredient cost at that month's prices and the list price then; the margin and the change in ingredient cost from the month before fill in.
One row for each job with the minutes planned and the minutes it really took; the gap in minutes and hours, the cost of the gap and the check fill in, and the baker phone is ready for a message.
The owner, the bakers, the decorators, the order assistant, the driver and the outside contacts with phone, weekly hours and hourly rate.

Price for the margin you want
Type the cost of one batch (one bake of a recipe), its servings and the servings you need; see the cost per serving, the batches to bake and the price per serving for your target margin.
Price per serving for your target margin
Custom cake quote by size, flavour and decoration
Choose the cake size, the flavour, the decoration level and the delivery zone; see the cost, the price, the delivery fee, the margin against your target and the deposit before you quote.
Total with delivery and sales tax
Type the guests and the servings for each guest; see the smallest cake size that serves them, its tiers, the kilograms of sponge, filling and frosting to prepare and its cost per serving.
Recipe scaler to a new batch size
Choose a product and the servings of the new batch; see the scale factor, the main ingredient quantities in grams, the eggs in pieces and the ingredient cost of the new batch.
Ingredient cost of the new batch
Type the total cost and the margin you want (the share of the price left after costs); see the price to list, the rounded price, the margin at that price, the markup and the price with sales tax.
Price for your standard target margin
Type the old and new price of an ingredient, the kilograms used a month and the monthly sales of the products that use it; see the extra cost and the price rise needed.
Monthly sales of the products that use it
Price rise needed to keep the profit

Cost of this ingredient, new, per month
Type the labour minutes of a plain cake, the rate, the decoration level and the plain price; see the labour with the decoration, the price add-on and what is left of it.
Labour minutes of the plain cake
Labour cost of the plain cake
Add-on left after the extra labour
Type the minutes, the oven power in kW, the tray loads and the units on a tray; see the kWh used, the cost of the bake, the cost per tray load and the cost per unit.
Cost of one hour of baking
Type the units in a box, the cost of one unit, the packaging and your margin; see the box cost, the box price, the price of each unit in the box and how it compares with the single price.
Packaging and ribbon for the box

Type the retail price, the discount for cafes and shops and the cost of one unit; see the wholesale price, the margin and the largest discount that keeps your wholesale margin goal.
Largest discount at your wholesale margin target
Retail profit lost on each unit
Type the cake price, the delivery fee and the deposit rule; see the total, the deposit (a part of the price paid to secure the date), the balance and the deposit kept on a late cancel.
Share of the deposit kept on a late cancel
Deposit kept on a late cancel
Discount impact on margin and orders needed
Type the price, the discount and the cost; see the margin before and after, the profit lost on each sale and how many extra orders you need to earn the same profit.
Orders a month at this price
Extra orders needed for the same profit
Profit lost a month with no extra orders
Type the fixed cost of a week, the price and the variable cost of one unit; see the margin per unit, the units a week that cover the cost, the units for your profit goal and the weekly sales needed.
Fixed cost of a week (rent, wages, energy)

What-if grid: price against units sold a week
Type the price, the unit cost, the units a week and the fixed cost; read the weekly profit and use the grid rows to see how a price and the units sold together move the profit.
Client: your cake quote is ready
Hello {client}, your quote {quote_id} for {product} is {quoted_price}. A deposit of {deposit} secures the date. Valid until {valid_until}.
Hello {client}, your quote {quote_id} expires on {valid_until}. Please tell us if you would like to go ahead.
Client: a smaller size fits your budget
Hello {client}, a smaller cake than the {servings} servings in quote {quote_id} would lower the price. Shall we send a new quote?
Client: the price for your cake changes
Hello {client}, our prices change after {valid_until}. Your quote {quote_id} stays at {quoted_price} until then.
Client: a deposit secures your date
Hello {client}, a deposit of {deposit} secures your date for quote {quote_id}. The balance is paid at pick-up or delivery.
Client: your quote with your decoration
Hello {client}, quote {quote_id} includes the {decoration} decoration you chose: {quoted_price} for {product}.
Client: a cupcake price for your event
Hello {client}, for your event the price of {product} is {quoted_price} for {servings} servings. Boxes can be ordered in more than one flavour.
Client: a cookie price for your party
Hello {client}, the price of {product} for your party is {quoted_price}. We can add a label or a ribbon on request.
Hello {client}, thank you for accepting quote {quote_id}. We will confirm the date and the details of {product} shortly.
Client: a larger cake for your guests
Hello {client}, if more guests come than the {servings} servings in quote {quote_id}, a larger size avoids a shortage. Shall we price it?
Client: the seasonal menu and prices
Hello {client}, our seasonal menu and prices are ready. Order early in busy weeks so that we can keep your date.
Client: a bundle offer for your order
Hello {client}, adding a box of cupcakes or cookies to quote {quote_id} gives you a better price for both. Would you like to see it?
Hello {account}, the new wholesale price of {product} is {wholesale_price} from {valid_from}. Please confirm that you received it.
Account: a price change on butter items
Hello {account}, butter prices rose and the price of {product} changes to {wholesale_price} from {valid_from}. Thank you for your understanding.
Hello {account}, your standing order price for {product} is {wholesale_price}. Tell us if you want to change the weekly units.
Account: a trial price for a new product
Hello {account}, we would like you to try {product} at {wholesale_price} for a month. Please tell us if you want to start.
Hello, please confirm today's price for {item}. Our list shows {new_cost}. Thank you.
Supplier: your price rose, fix it for us
Hello, the price of {item} changed from {old_cost} to {new_cost}. Can we agree a fixed price for the next three months?
Supplier: a larger order, what discount
Hello, we plan a larger order of {item}. What discount can you offer on {new_cost} per unit?
Supplier: a quote for new boxes
Hello, please send a quote for new boxes and labels. Your current price for {item} is {new_cost}. Thank you.
Team: the recipe for a product changed
